_meta.comment: Flat name -> exact samples() snippet (validate.py load_deps sends the value verbatim). _meta is documentation only and is never a legal dep. Preloaded packs (loaded by livecode.html at init): tidal-drum-machines, uzu-drumkit, piano, vcsl - declaring them as deps is legal and harmless.
_meta.tidal-drum-machines: Use via .bank(). Verified banks: RolandTR808/909/707/505, AkaiLinn, RhythmAce, ViscoSpaceDrum, RolandCompurhythm1000, CasioRZ1. ~0s (preloaded).
_meta.uzu-drumkit: Bare names: bd sd hh oh cp cr rd rim sh tb cb lt mt ht + brk (breakbeat) + misc. ~0s (preloaded).
_meta.vcsl: 128 orchestral/mallet/world instruments (see BUNDLE.md list). Mallets are quiet - gain up. ~0s (preloaded).
_meta.wavetables: 65 AKWF wavetables, wt_* prefixed (see BUNDLE.md). ~2s load.
_meta.clean-breaks: NO clean:N names! Named breaks: amen, think, apache, funkydrummer, king, sport, kool, around, riffin, neworleans, hitormiss, action, hotline, swat, ripple, fireeater, hungup, newday, movement, boogiewoogie, delight, eeloil, impeach, marymary, sneakin, squib, groove, useme, sesame, do, rill, mechanicalman. ~2s load.
_meta.dirt-samples: 218 sounds. Verified: amencutup, speech, speechless, speakspell, diphone, diphone2, alphabet, numbers, yeah (0-27), miniyeah, ades2-4, baa, east, breath. ~2s load; individual folders fetch lazily on first hit.
_meta.shabda-vox-f: TTS female voice, en-US. Each word registers as its OWN sound name: s("moonlight"), s("velvet")... Words chosen to not collide with dirt-samples names. EXTERNAL SERVICE at load time (shabda.ndre.gr) - may take ~5s; validation may need one re-queue while it warms. ~5s load.
_meta.shabda-vox-m: TTS male voice, en-US. Sound names: s("rewind"), s("heavyweight")... Same caveats as shabda-vox-f.
